# Ponup

> Ponup is an open-source context engineering and content management platform for people and AI agents. It turns organizational knowledge into governed, searchable, source-linked context and can be self-hosted or used through Ponup Cloud.

Ponup organizes knowledge into focused Spaces, supports Markdown, structured JSON, PDFs, text files, and images, and exposes context through MCP, REST, GraphQL, public links, and a web workspace. The open-source core is MIT licensed and uses portable infrastructure including PostgreSQL, pgvector, and S3-compatible storage.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://ponup.com/): Product overview, features, supported interfaces, deployment options, and architecture.
- [Pricing](https://ponup.com/pricing/): Community, Cloud, and Scale plans, limits, and frequently asked questions.
- [Contact](https://ponup.com/contact/): Contact Ponup about Cloud, self-hosting, enterprise needs, or technical questions.
- [Use cases](https://ponup.com/use-cases/): Ways teams use Ponup to make organizational knowledge available to people and AI.
- [Alternatives](https://ponup.com/alternatives/): Comparisons between Ponup and other knowledge or retrieval approaches.

## Use cases

- [AI agents](https://ponup.com/use-cases/ai-agents/): A shared, attributable context layer for assistants, copilots, automations, and agent workflows.
- [Customer support](https://ponup.com/use-cases/customer-support/): Unified public and internal support knowledge for people and automated assistants.
- [Product teams](https://ponup.com/use-cases/product-teams/): Durable access to research, decisions, specifications, and product rationale.

## Comparisons

- [Ponup vs Notion](https://ponup.com/alternatives/notion-alternative/): Compare an all-in-one collaboration workspace with a focused context delivery layer.
- [Ponup vs Confluence](https://ponup.com/alternatives/confluence-alternative/): Compare an Atlassian-centered collaboration hub with portable knowledge infrastructure.
- [Ponup vs a custom RAG stack](https://ponup.com/alternatives/custom-rag-alternative/): Compare building retrieval infrastructure from components with adopting Ponup's reusable context layer.
